previous_statement: By the meaning of a triangulation, triangulating M into the cells of a finite complex K supplies a homeomorphism from the geometric realization of the finite simplicial complex K onto M; therefore M is homeomorphic to a finite simplicial complex.
new_statement: If M is triangulated into the cells of a finite complex K, then by the meaning of triangulation K is a finite simplicial complex and the triangulation supplies a homeomorphism from its geometric realization |K| onto M; hence M is homeomorphic to a finite simplicial complex.
